label: Если бы
description: A 10-sentence card for the unreal conditional frame Если бы …, … бы.

missions.phrase: Если бы я знал, я бы тебе сказал.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Full unreal conditional. Both clauses use a past-form verb with бы, marking the whole situation as counterfactual. The speaker did not know, so nothing was said. Here бы sits right after если and again after я.

missions.phrase: Если бы было время, мы бы погуляли.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Hypothetical with no real time. The particle бы always combines with a past-tense verb form, so было and погуляли are both past though the meaning is timeless. The walk did not happen because the time was lacking.

missions.phrase: Если бы ты позвонил, я бы пришла.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Unreal cause and result. Позвонил sets the imagined condition, пришла the imagined outcome, both past plus бы. The call never came, so the arrival is purely hypothetical.

missions.phrase: Если бы он захотел, он бы остался.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Counterfactual choice. бы is a mood particle, not a tense, so the past verbs захотел and остался signal irrealis rather than past time. His staying is unreal because the wish was absent.

missions.phrase: Если бы мы поехали раньше, успели бы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Mobile бы in the result. The result clause drops its subject and places бы after the verb успели. The earlier departure is imagined, so making it on time is too.

missions.phrase: Если бы она была здесь, всё было бы проще.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Two-clause irrealis with было бы. Each clause carries its own past form with бы, the hallmark of the unreal conditional. Her absence is the reason everything is harder.

missions.phrase: Если бы у нас были деньги, мы бы купили дом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imagined possession and purchase. The condition были and the result купили are both past plus бы, framing money we do not have. Без денег the purchase stays hypothetical.

missions.phrase: Если бы ты меня слушал, ты бы понял.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Reproach as unreal conditional. The two-clause structure pairs слушал with понял, each past plus бы. Since the listening did not happen, the understanding did not either.

missions.phrase: Если бы погода была лучше, мы бы пошли на пляж.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Weather-based counterfactual. The imagined better weather licenses the imagined trip, была and пошли both past with бы. The actual weather blocks the beach outing.

missions.phrase: Если бы они приехали, мы бы их встретили.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Unreal arrival and welcome. Приехали and встретили are past forms carrying бы, so both events belong to an imagined world. They did not come, so no one met them.
